{{Infobox league |name=QWSL DIV2 |image=Qwsldiv2-logo.png |series= |organizer={{player|Hooraytio|flag=se}} {{player|Link|flag=no}} {{player|Doomie|flag=pl}} |sponsor= |type=Online |format=4on4 |prizepool= |sdate=2025.12.01 |edate=2026.03.29 |year=2025/26 |website= |discord=discord.gg/EaDUYqRDGM |twitch= |teamfirst= |teamfirstflag= |teamsecond= |teamsecondflag= |teamthird= |teamthirdflag= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |team_number= |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 |map4=schloss |map5=qobblestone |map6=anwalked |map7=defer }} {{Tabs static |name1=Overview |link1=QWSL DIV2 |name2=Rules |link2=QWSL DIV2/rules |name3=Teams |link3=QWSL DIV2/teams |name4=Standings |link4=QWSL DIV2/standings |This=1 }} '''QWSL DIV2''' is a [[4on4]] league for "div2 players" only. Basicly it is a league for everyone, except for strong div1 players. The intention is to make div2 strong again and try to get a real div2 going. An average div1 player can participate under certain conditions; you need to make a team that compensates for the div1 player, for example have 2 x div3 (or low div2) on the team. The main goal is to get teams signed up that are not too strong. We would actually encourage some div1 players to make such a team, it would be good for div2 recruitement. '''It is the admins who decide if a team will be allowed to participate or not.''' == Format == It will be one big division with normal round robin games; 11 teams = 10 games each. Game of 3. 8 teams to playoff: Winner of Quarterfinals to Playoff A, losers to Playoff B. So top 8 teams get 3 games of Bo5 in the playoffs. Teams that place 9, 10 and 11 will play a round robin group with 2 games each, to settle placements 9 to 11. 2 games of Bo5 each. == Game Procedure == Because it is 7 maps the game will be played with the following map procedure: '''toss toss pick pick toss toss play''' Bo5 playoff: '''toss toss pick pick pick pick play''' == Reporting Games == Captains of each team report the games on discord. == Timeframe == Deadline dates: Round 1 - 7th of December

== Signup == You signup by PMing one of the admins: '''Hooraytio''' or '''Link''' '''Deadline''': 30th of November == Single Players == If you are a single player without a team you can still signup, the admins will help all single players and gather info to all so that it is possible to form teams. == Maps == {{Maps |title= |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 |map4=schloss |map5=qobblestone |map6=anwalked |map7=defer }} __NOTOC__
